mainText:
Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 10 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 8, low 0.

Albania will receive 15% more money from the EU Growth Plan for the Western Balkans, thanks to a redistribution mechanism that shifts funds originally set aside for Kosovo.

North Macedonia has completed 56% of the reforms required under the EU Growth Plan and will receive €71 million in funding.

Switzerland has pledged 1 million Swiss francs to a four-year project in Albania aimed at strengthening intellectual property protection and fostering innovation.

Manchester United midfielder Carlos Baleba will miss the rest of the season, with manager Mauricio Pochettino confirming a muscle injury that could keep him out for up to three months.

The European Automobile Manufacturers Association has asked the EU to include existing Turkish car factories in the bloc's "Made in EU" rules.
